details.description: Geef Magic Pops Grape Flavour Popping Candy brings a burst of juicy grape flavour with an exciting popping sensation. This fun, fizzy treat crackles on your tongue, offering a delightful and playful experience. Tasty, easy to chew, and quick to dissolve, it’s a sweet surprise for kids and adults alike.
details.usageInstructions: Tear open the pack and pour the candy on your tongue; it pops and fizzes. Enjoy as a candy.
details.dangerWarnings: Not suitable for children below 3 years as it may cause choking. Do not use if the pack is damaged.
